name: Death Stranding Director's Cut
native_kbm_note: No source found showing keyboard/mouse gameplay support on PS5; 505 Games' FAQ confirms keyboard and mouse only for the PC version. Not explicitly confirmed for PS5.
notes: PC keys from shacknews, strategywiki and magicgameworld. PS buttons from magicgameworld, culturedvultures and samurai-gamers (X jump, Circle posture, Square action, Triangle load cargo, L1 compass, R1 scan / hold breath (hold), L2/R2 left/right-hand balance, L3 sprint, R3 switch camera side, D-pad up equipment / right tools / left items / down structures, Touchpad call out, Options pause / Cuff Links). Mouse buttons follow the balance actions (LMB = left = L2, RMB = right = R2). On PC, RMB also readies/aims an item and LMB fires, and no PS source confirmed which buttons do that on PS5, so combat aim/fire may feel swapped; test it. Left out: PC walk (Ctrl, analog only on PS), reload (R), melee (V), ammo type (Z), cargo menu (I) and select structure, because no reliable PS5 or PC counterpart was found.
